_note: Edit contest names, briefs, dates and prizes here, then rebuild. 'closes' is an ISO date; a contest whose date has passed is shown as closed.

contests.name: The 90-word pitch
contests.brief: Write the first outbound email for a domain you own or an invented one. Ninety words or fewer. It must say what you own, why it fits the reader, how a sale would work, and give an easy way to say no.
contests.judged: Clarity, honesty and whether a busy founder would reply.
contests.prize: The winning email is published with credit on this page and featured on the home page for a month. A cash prize is added whenever a sponsor or reader contributions fund one, and is announced here before entries close.

contests.name: For-sale page of the season
contests.brief: Build a for-sale page for a domain you own, with the builder on this site or by hand. Send the live address.
contests.judged: Does a first-time visitor on a phone understand it is for sale, see how to act, and trust the page, inside five seconds.
contests.prize: The winning page is featured in the for-sale page playbook with a link and credit. A cash prize is added whenever a sponsor or reader contributions fund one, and is announced here before entries close.

contests.name: Name the startup
contests.brief: We describe an invented company in two sentences on this page each season. Propose one unregistered or owned-by-you domain for it, and one sentence on why.
contests.judged: The phone test, length, and fit with the brief. Names that lean on an existing trademark are disqualified.
contests.prize: The winning name and its author are credited on this page. A cash prize is added whenever a sponsor or reader contributions fund one, and is announced here before entries close.

season_brief: A two-person company that helps independent bakeries take pre-orders online and plan the morning bake. Friendly, practical, not techy.
